verdict.rationale: Kimi documents web search in its CLI and editor surfaces and lists search and Deep Research (深度研究) among its assistant features. A hands-on user also saw it pull from Wikipedia when answering, so grounding in web results is supported. Missing for 10: any documentation that answers include citations or links back to sources, detail on how fresh the results are, and in-depth first-party docs for the assistant's search beyond help-index headings.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can get answers grounded in current web results with citations back to the sources

citations.quote: execute commands, search the web, and autonomously complete development tasks
